# futureverse: Install ‘Futureverse’ in One Go

## Installation

R package futureverse is available on
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=futureverse) and can be
installed in R as:

``` r
install.packages("futureverse")
```

### Pre-release version

To install the pre-release version that is available in Git branch
`develop` on GitHub, use:

``` r
remotes::install_github("futureverse/futureverse", ref="develop")
```

This will install the package from source.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`futureverse_deps()`](https://futureverse.futureverse.org/reference/futureverse_deps.md)
  : List all Futureverse dependencies
- [`futureverse_packages()`](https://futureverse.futureverse.org/reference/futureverse_packages.md)
  : List all packages in the Futureverse
- [`futureverse_update()`](https://futureverse.futureverse.org/reference/futureverse_update.md)
  : Update Futureverse packages
